notes: Per point and arm, every scheduled draw is in the denominator; an invalid reply or a failed request is an outcome, not a dropped draw.

Financial evidence v1's definitions, unchanged, at the recorded state; long-run outcomes under the fixed suffix are a mechanics check and are not attributed to the preview.
